read.description: Read a LibreLane run directory and give typed records, without a tool run. Inputs: run (runs/<tag>, relative to the design root), against (optional; a second run, or "auto" for the sibling run with the fewest different settings: adds the comparison), launcher (optional; a list of files that started the run: their hashes go into the record, with the hashes of the design inputs that the run names). Measurements: setup_ws_ns@<corner> and hold_ws_ns@<corner>, each from the last step that computed it, with its evidence level (no_wires, placement_estimate, global_route, extracted) and the step; steps, steps_not_done, instances, utilization, clock_buffers, timing_repair_buffers, route_usage_pct (over the die), core_route_usage_pct_estimate, route_overflow. Warnings: a corner whose newest slack has a lower level than the run (the metrics of the last state carry it from an earlier step); a corner name that does not agree with the header of the library that it loaded; a step that did not end; a repair table with a known pattern; a design input newer than the run. Use it before you report a number of a run.

compare.description: Compare two LibreLane runs, without a tool run: the settings that differ, the first step that reads one of them, and the first step whose netlists or metrics differ. Inputs: run, against. Measurements: settings_changed, steps_compared, steps_different, effect (1: the results differ at or after the first step that reads a changed setting; 0: no step differs, the setting had no effect; failed: the runs differ before that step, so another input differs and the comparison does not show the effect of the setting). Use it before you record that a setting changed a result.

replay.description: Run one step of a LibreLane run again on its saved input state, with changed variables, in the work directory of the experiment. The run directory is not changed. Inputs: run, step (the step number, directory name or id), set (optional; an object of flow variables for this step, for example {"PNR_CORNERS": ["<corner>"]} for a timing step at another corner, or a repair or clock tree variable), state_in (optional; a state file to start from: the state_out.json of an earlier replay chains two replays, for example a second repair pass). Measurements: the metrics that differ from the step in the run, metrics_changed, views_changed, runtime_s. A variable that the step does not read fails the request, with the steps that read it. A replay that changes no metric and no netlist gives a warning: the setting has no effect at this step. Use it for an A/B test of one option, or for a timing number at a corner that the flow did not analyse at this step, instead of a full run.

preflight.description: Check the environment of the digital flow before a long run. Inputs: tools (optional; a list of tool names), pdk_root and pdk (optional; default $PDK_ROOT and $PDK), min_free_gb (optional, default 5). It starts the version command of each flow tool (librelane, openroad, sta, yosys, klayout, magic, netgen, verilator, iverilog, vvp) with the PATH of the librelane launcher, lists the view counts of each library of the PDK, and checks the free space and a write. Measurements: tools_ok, tools_failed, pdk_libraries, disk_free_gb, writable. Warnings: a tool that is not found or does not start; two builds of a tool with different versions; a PDK that is not found; low free space; a failed write. The report has the path and the version line of each tool: the record of the tool versions of the run.
